The image is a vertical magazine cover with a tan background. At the top, the large black word "TEMPO" is centered above the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". A small black "55" is to the right. White text at the top left reads "Peras-peras Tambang Ilegal Samin Tan H.60", and at the top right, "Pepesan Kosong Penguatan OJK H.72". 

Centered left, large white capital letters state "PT NASDEM INDONESIA RAYA TBK". Smaller white text below reads: "Prabowo Subianto dan Surya Paloh menggagas penggabungan Partai Gerindra dengan Partai NasDem. Paceklik di luar kekuasaan. H.28".

The main subject is a middle-aged man with a black beard and balding head, illustrated in a white button-down shirt and blue trousers. He is walking barefoot on a cracked, yellowish-brown ground. His shirt is untucked, and his expression is somber. Behind him on the ground lie a discarded dark jacket and two black shoes. 

The bottom left corner contains white text including "13-19 APRIL 2026", "RP 60.000", "TEMPO.CO/MINGGUAN", and a barcode with a QR code.
